title: metadata: a draft save accepts an object name without the package namespace prefix; only publish-drafts refuses it (NAMESPACE_PREFIX)
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a product defect found by a QA run (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8). This is the same draft-vs-publish parity class as #26707.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase and sign in as admin.
2. `POST /api/v1/packages` with `{"manifest":{"id":"qa.scratch.r2","name":"QA Scratch R2","version":"0.0.1","type":"app"}}`. The resulting namespace is `r2`.
3. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_formula_pkg_r2?mode=draft&package=qa.scratch.r2` with a valid object body. The name has no `r2_` prefix.
4. Expected: the draft read's `_diagnostics` carries the NAMESPACE_PREFIX finding, as #26707 made it carry the other publish rules.
5. Actual: 200 `state:"draft"`, and the diagnostics report valid. Then `POST /api/v1/packages/qa.scratch.r2/publish-drafts` answers `outcome:"refused"` with code NAMESPACE_PREFIX. The refusal rolls back the whole batch.

QA run R10 met the same thing: `badprefix_thing` was staged beside two valid drafts, and publish-drafts refused all three.

## Mechanism
In `packages/metadata-protocol`'s `protocol.ts`, the prefix check runs only when `mode === 'publish'` (~L20718, "a draft is judged when it is promoted"). `objectNamespacePrefixViolation(` is called at ~L20721, L22997 and L23766, none of which is the draft-verdict path that #26856 added (~L7181 / ~L10769).

## Expected after fix
The draft verdict equals the publish verdict for the namespace-prefix rule, so Studio's Problems view names the bad object before publish.
